pins.head: THE OTTOMAN OPENS UP
pins.title: Small Apartment on a Budget: Choose Furniture That Stores Something
pins.desc: In a small apartment every piece should do two jobs. A lidded ottoman is a footrest and a box for blankets, and fabric bins turn an open console into closed storage you can actually look at. None of it costs more than the plain version of the same furniture. Contains affiliate links. #SmallApartment #BudgetDecor #StorageIdeas
pins.alt: A white media console holding a television, books and terracotta and teal fabric bins, with a cream lidded storage ottoman in front and a sofa with a throw beside it.

pins.head: CLEAR EDGES DISAPPEAR
pins.title: Acne Patches: Thin, Clear Edges Are What Make One Wearable in Daylight
pins.desc: A patch that works overnight is not always one you would wear to work. The edge is what shows, so look for a thin, tapered rim and a matte or clear finish, and keep the thicker overnight ones for the hours when nobody is looking. Contains affiliate links. #AcnePatches #SkincareBasics #PersonalCare
pins.alt: A sheet of small round hydrocolloid patches lying on a white bathroom counter beside a shallow ceramic dish, with folded towels on the windowsill behind.

pins.head: THE CADDY HANGS ITSELF
pins.title: Shower Storage Without Drilling: A Caddy That Hangs or Tensions in Place
pins.desc: Adhesive hooks give up in steam and suction cups drop their load at the worst moment. A caddy that hangs from the shower arm or tensions into a corner carries the same bottles with nothing stuck to the tile, and it comes down to be rinsed. Contains affiliate links. #ShowerStorage #BathroomIdeas #RentalHome
pins.alt: A white wire caddy holding bottles and a sponge inside a glass shower enclosure, with a teal towel on the shower door and a shelf unit of baskets and rolled towels over the toilet.

pins.head: NEST THE SHAPES BEFORE CUTTING
pins.title: Vinyl Roll Yield: Nesting the Shapes Decides How Many Decals You Get
pins.desc: Two people cutting the same decal from the same roll can get very different counts. Lay the shapes out so they interlock and sit close to the edge before you send the cut, and the offcuts shrink from wide strips to slivers you would have thrown away anyway. Contains affiliate links. #VinylCrafts #CricutMade #CraftingTips
pins.alt: A roll of pale adhesive vinyl partly unrolled across a gridded cutting mat beside a long metal ruler and a sheet of pale green vinyl.

pins.head: SOME JOBS WANT COLD GLUE
pins.title: Clear Craft Glue With a Two-Way Applicator for Paper and Fine Work
pins.desc: Hot glue is fast and leaves a bead you can see, which is wrong for paper, photos and anything thin. A clear glue that dries invisible handles those, and a two-way tip gives a fine line for edges or a broad spread for a whole sheet without changing bottles. Contains affiliate links. #CraftSupplies #PaperCrafts #CraftGlue
pins.alt: A hot glue gun resting on a wooden stand beside a white squeeze bottle of clear craft glue and a small terracotta pot on a wooden workbench, with jars on a shelf behind.

pins.head: ONE TRAY FOR THE SMALL THINGS
pins.title: Small Desk Reset: One Shallow Tray Instead of Clutter Across the Surface
pins.desc: Pens, clips and a charger left loose spread until they own the desk. A single shallow tray gives them one address, which makes the rest of the surface easy to wipe and easy to leave empty at the end of the day. Anything that will not fit the tray needs a drawer. Contains affiliate links. #DeskOrganization #HomeOffice #WorkFromHome
pins.alt: A wooden desk by a window with a wooden desk organizer holding pens, a laptop on a riser, a white upright file sorter and a woven basket under the desk.

pins.head: A MINUTE NOW, A BRUSH LATER
pins.sub: Rinse, Blot and Stand Them Up
pins.title: Brush Care: A One-Minute Rinse and Reset Saves the Bristles
pins.desc: Acrylic that dries in the ferrule is what ruins a brush, not painting with it. Rinse while the paint is still wet, blot the water out on a cloth, then stand the brushes bristles-up in a holder so nothing presses on the hairs. That is the whole routine and it takes a minute. Contains affiliate links. #PaintBrushCare #AcrylicPainting #StudioHabits
pins.alt: Paint brushes standing bristles-up in a slotted wooden holder beside a glass water jar and a folded cloth on a bright workbench, with jars on a shelf behind.

pins.head: THE FLOOR IS THE LAST SHELF
pins.title: Tiny Closet: The Floor Is Storage, Once Something Keeps It Tidy
pins.desc: The strip of floor under hanging clothes usually turns into a pile. Clear stackable boxes make it a shelf instead, with the pair you want visible from the front, and they keep the hems of whatever hangs above them from brushing the ground. Contains affiliate links. #ClosetOrganization #ShoeStorage #RenterHacks
pins.alt: A small closet with a two-tier hanging rod holding shirts and trousers, a hanging shelf with folded sweaters, baskets on the top shelf and clear stackable shoe boxes on the floor.

pins.head: COUNT PODS, WEIGH POWDER
pins.sub: Dosing by Load, Not by Habit
pins.title: Laundry Detergent: Pods Are Counted, Powder Has to Be Measured
pins.desc: A pod is one dose whether the load is full or half, which is convenient and why it costs more per wash. Powder lets you scoop to the size of the load, so the small loads cost less. Pick the format by how often you run a half load, not by what is on offer. Contains affiliate links. #LaundryTips #HouseholdEssentials #CleaningRoutine
pins.alt: A glass jar with a cork lid filled with laundry pods standing on a wooden counter beside a kraft box with a scoop resting in it and a stack of folded towels.

pins.head: HEIGHT WITHOUT A BRACKET
pins.title: Renter Storage: Gaining Height With Nothing Screwed Into the Wall
pins.desc: Wall storage is the thing a lease usually rules out. A leaning shelf takes books and plants up the wall while standing on the floor, and a pocket organizer on the back of a door holds the small things. Neither needs a bracket, and both leave with you. Contains affiliate links. #RenterFriendly #NoDrillStorage #SmallSpaceHacks
pins.alt: A leaning wooden shelf holding books and plants beside a sofa with teal cushions and an ottoman, with a pocket organizer hanging on the door at the right.

pins.head: ZERO CARB, ZERO FLAVOR
pins.title: Unflavored Whey Isolate Protein Powder in a 1 lb Starter Tub
pins.desc: Flavored powder decides what you can put it in. An unflavored isolate goes into coffee, oats or a plain shaker without turning the whole thing into dessert, and a one pound tub is small enough to finish before you find out you dislike it. Contains affiliate links. #ProteinPowder #WheyIsolate #NutritionBasics
pins.alt: A large cream tub of protein powder with a scoop resting on top, beside a shaker bottle with a grey lid, its own lid and a folded towel on a pale kitchen counter.

pins.head: LEAVE A FINGER OF GAP
pins.title: Kitchen Bin Sizing: Leave a Finger of Clearance or It Will Not Come Out
pins.desc: A bin measured to the exact inside width goes in once and then scrapes every time. Take a little off each dimension so there is room for your fingers at the sides, and check the height against the shelf above rather than the shelf it stands on. Contains affiliate links. #PantryOrganization #KitchenStorage #StorageBins
pins.alt: Clear stackable storage bins holding utensils and packets inside a wooden kitchen cabinet, with a yellow tape measure lying on the shelf in front of them.
